title: The plastics problem: a qualitative life cycle analysis case study for green and sustainable chemistry education
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00001K, Paper

Emergent efforts to incorporate green chemistry into the undergraduate curriculum has led to the development and testing of a case study focusing on the decision-making process around single-use plastics.
